image.alt: Chest compressions on a CPR manikin

settings.editor: RCR Rive-Sud is a private company specializing in CPR training. Our mission is to share practical knowledge and build the hands-on skills needed to respond to cardiopulmonary arrest and help save lives.
Our training is for the general public, workers, healthcare professionals and healthcare students.
Our approach focuses on practice, realistic scenarios and learning the essential skills that can make all the difference in an emergency.
We offer in-person training, mainly on Montreal's South Shore, with the option to travel to other areas on request.
CPR and interventions for adults. Suited to offices, retail and some industrial settings. Approx. 2 h, 2-year certification.
Adults, children and infants. Suited to parents, daycare and school staff, coaches and healthcare professionals. Approx. 3.5 h.
For healthcare professionals, alone or within a resuscitation team. Theory, practice and simulations. Approx. 4–5 h, 1-year certification.
Add-on module on request: Anaphylaxis, short format (1.5 h) or detailed format (4 h).
Practise the essential skills on manikins and take part in realistic scenarios.
Spot the signs of cardiac arrest and certain critical situations.
Practise chest compressions and proper ventilations.
Use an automated external defibrillator safely.
Apply the right airway obstruction techniques.
For your business, your facility or a private group, contact us to check availability and get a quote tailored to your needs. You choose the place; we handle the training.
